h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tirunelveli

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tirunelveli

items.pText: From June to September, strong winds blow across the plains of southern Tamil Nadu, which is why the country around Tirunelveli is dotted with wind turbines. Those winds matter when you put up a playground with roofs, panels and swings. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, colleges, colonies and parks in Tirunelveli at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,290 km away.

Tirunelveli sits on the Thamirabarani river and is known for its halwa and the Nellaiappar temple. It is hot for most of the year, with the main rain from October to December. Equipment reaches Tirunelveli by road, and installation is done by our own team or a dealer in the south. Send us photos of the site and tell us which way the wind usually comes from, and we will plan the layout with that in mind.

richText.heading: Installing play equipment on a windy site

c: On open ground that takes the full force of the wind, grout the posts into concrete footings instead of using self-standing bases. Tall structures with roofs or solid panels catch the most wind, so a lower
or a compact station may suit an exposed corner better. Keep the tallest piece behind a building or a row of trees if you can.

Do not tie cloth shade sails over the equipment without proper fixings, as the wind lifts and tears them. Fine dust also blows in during the windy months, so check swing bearings and wipe slides more often then. Bearings carry a 1-year warranty and galvanised pipes 3 years. See also

items.q: Is grouting better than self-standing on a windy site?
items.a: Usually, yes. Posts set into concrete footings stay firm when strong winds hit tall structures. We suggest the method for each piece on the layout drawing.

items.q: Which pieces suit an exposed, windy ground?
items.a: Lower structures with fewer solid panels, such as climbers, see-saws and compact stations. Tall towers with roofs are better placed behind a building or trees.
Yes. We send the equipment by road from our Vasai East factory and install it with our own team or a dealer in south India.
